page.overview:
Who is Arn Mikals?

Arn Mikals was the creator of the Paladin 9200 Combat Training Program.

Arn Mikals was assigned a lab in Testing Station No. 163 where he created the Paladin 9200 Combat Training Program. He grew found of the thinking machine, which he called "Pal", and regarded it as his best friend. Mikals was later informed that the project had been shut down and ordered to destroy the Paladin system. He refused to do it and dismissed his staff and was determined to convince the comittee to change their minds. He told Pal that he would return shortly, though he never did, presumably being imprisoned or killed for his defiance.

The Prisoner entered the lab and discovered Pal, as well as Mikals' last recording before his departure. From the recording, they learned the passcode they could use to access the Paladin system. Once they did, Pal mistook them for Mikals and was overjoyed at their reunion.
